show.description: Bunty Weds Babli is a romantic comedy set in Allahabad where two strangers, Ritika and Raghav, are unknowingly married through their grandparents’ old love story. A year later, they meet at work as boss and assistant, fall in love without realizing they are husband and wife, and end up unknowingly filing for divorce from each other.
